---
title: "link-external: newwindow only"
# bd-t3n1nghb: `link-external-newwindow` alone sets target/rel and adds
# no class. Without `site-url` or a filter, any absolute http(s) link
# is external; localhost is not.
format:
  html:
    link-external-newwindow: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['a[href="https://example.com/"][target="_blank"][rel="noopener"]']
        - ['a.external', 'a[href^="http://localhost"][target]']
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - []
        - ['bootstrap-icons\.css']
---

[External](https://example.com/) and [local](http://localhost:4200/x.html).
